cards.name: Automation
cards.summary: Workspace 'Automation' (Window > Workspace > Automation): Workspace for running and building automation, with the Actions panel standing alone. Layout read from the file: tools: the Basic toolbar in one narrow column; Control bar: shown. Right dock, expanded panels (tab groups): [Actions]; [Links, Libraries, Document Info]; [Variables, Appearance, Asset Export]; [Layers, Artboards]. Right dock, collapsed to icons: [Color, Color Guide]; [Swatches, Brushes, Symbols]; [Stroke, Gradient, Transparency]; [Graphic Styles]. Panel ids in the stored layout are named here by their usual panel names; most workspaces also keep the Commenting and Stock content tabs in the icon strip (Getting Started has only Commenting; Start has neither). Not visual: no thumbnail, and the live arrangement may differ if the workspace was edited.
use_for: recording and playing Actions
data-driven artwork with the Variables panel
production and batch clean-up jobs
avoid: freehand illustration: the Color, Swatches and Brushes groups are only collapsed icons; use Painting or Essentials Classic
assuming it runs anything: it only arranges panels; actions and scripts must still be run
cards.applies_to: the Illustrator application window (a UI layout, not artwork): it moves the toolbar, Control bar and panel groups; no document is needed and nothing in a document changes
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Workspace > Automation. Script: no loader call was harvested (invoke holds only the workspace file <Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Workspaces/Automation), so switch from the menu.

verified.note: Not visual: re-parsed the workspace file myself; Basic narrow toolbar, Control bar open, expanded groups Actions / Links-Libraries-Document Info / Variables-Appearance-Export / Layers-Artboards and the four icon groups all match.
